name: People Who Are Trouble Makers
overview: Scripture acknowledges the presence of troublemakers—those who cause divisions and offenses contrary to sound doctrine—and exhorts believers to avoid them while responding with humility and restoration when possible. The Christian life involves spiritual warfare against unseen forces of darkness that influence such individuals, requiring believers to be equipped with the full armor of God to stand firm. Despite the inevitable tribulations brought by these challenges, Christ offers peace and victory over the world, encouraging believers to remain steadfast and of good cheer.
